serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Landlord: What?! You are still here?! The crew is ready to start making the changes!
You: Sorry, you didn’t tell me it was supposed to be today.
Landlord: Excuses, excuses! Get the hell out of here you two! I don’t pay those workers to stand around and do nothing!
You: Let us just grab a few things-
Landlord: {{punch}}There’s no time for that! Get out of here, you two!
As he was saying this he grabbed my arm and forcefully pushed me out of the doorstep…
Landlord: Come on guys! Get in and get to work.
After he said that a bunch of zombie-like creatures in blue dungarees stormed into my apartment…
There was no light in their eyes. Truly, being employed by the landlord is a fate worse than death.
My thoughts were abruptly stopped by two of the workers grabbing {f_botName} like a bag of potatoes and throwing her right at me.
You: Ugh!{{punch}}
